intro: Lakshmi Narayana College and Pentakanti Law College both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded Integrated Law fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Lakshmi Narayana College vs Pentakanti Law College is not a single winner. Lakshmi Narayana College is recorded as a public institute, while Pentakanti Law College is private. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Lakshmi Narayana College vs Pentakanti Law College for Integrated Law: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Lakshmi Narayana College if you want a public Integrated Law option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose Pentakanti Law College if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.
Lakshmi Narayana College lists B.Com LLB, BA.LLB. Pentakanti Law College lists BA.LLB.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records list ₹1 lakh a year as total fees for Lakshmi Narayana College's B.Com LLB. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
Our records list ₹16,000 a year as tuition fees for Pentakanti Law College's BA.LLB. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Lakshmi Narayana College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh for B.Com LLB. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
In our records, Pentakanti Law College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh for BA.LLB. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Lakshmi Narayana College's recorded admission tests on this page include LAWCET.
Pentakanti Law College's recorded admission tests on this page include LAWCET.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, Lakshmi Narayana College is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
Pentakanti Law College can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
